```{python}
#| label: fig-nmos-gate-sweep
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Cross section of an NMOS transistor for increasing gate voltage (drain and source grounded): (a) flatband condition, (b) gate at 0 V, (c) gate below the threshold voltage, and (d) inversion. The dashed line marks the depletion-region boundary, circled minus signs are ionized acceptors, plus signs are holes, and the dark blue layer in (d) is the electron inversion layer."

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from pyutil.mosfig import draw_nmos

panels = [
    ('flatband', r'$V_\mathrm{G} = V_\mathrm{fb} < 0\,$V', r'$V_\mathrm{D} = 0\,$V', '(a)'),
    ('zero', r'$V_\mathrm{G} = 0\,$V', r'$V_\mathrm{D} = 0\,$V', '(b)'),
    ('depletion', r'$0\,\mathrm{V} < V_\mathrm{G} < V_\mathrm{th}$', r'$V_\mathrm{D} = 0\,$V', '(c)'),
    ('inversion', r'$V_\mathrm{G} > V_\mathrm{th}$', r'$V_\mathrm{D} = 0\,$V', '(d)'),
]

fig, axs = plt.subplots(4, 1, figsize=(8, 10))
for ax, (state, vg, vd, tag) in zip(axs.flat, panels):
    draw_nmos(ax, state, vg, vd)
    ax.set_ylim(-0.3, 6.1)
    ax.text(-1.2, 5.9, tag, fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
